story.title: Party in the Jungle
paragraphs_en: Story - Party in the Jungle Omprakash Kshatriya "Prakash" " Kukoo , why are you sad?", asked Becto
"I am sad because nobody dances or sings in the jungle ", said Kukoo, "and I feel like dancing and singing ."
"That is because no one knows how to dance and sing," said Becto, "but, I have an idea! Why don't you teach others how to dance and sing! Then we can have a party in the Jungle!"
"Come one! Let's start with you!" said Kukoo while giving Becto a few lines to sing. Now, whenever he gets time, Becto sings and dances!
Becto's mother Gungun loved his dancing and singing. She taught him how to sing a few more songs.
Now, wherever he would go, Becto would sing and dance. By practising over and over again, he became an expert in dancing and singing.
Becto's friend Juju loved his dancing and singing and asked Becto to teach him too.
Kukoo was very happy with the way Becto was practising. "Becto, you are a very fast learner !", said Kukoo while congratulating him.

"Ma'am, I want to master singing and dancing very quickly , which is why I am working so hard," said Becto. To this Kukoo replied, "If you wish to learn quicker , then start teaching your friends too." "Yes ma'am!," Becto said as he went to his friends.
"My friends! Come on! Come here! Let's have some fun by learning how to dance and sing," shouted Becto to all.
First came Forgo, the Frog . Becto taught him how to dance and sing.
Then came Dakdak the Duck and Hariyal the Parrot . Becto taught them how to sing and dance too.
﻿Together, they began practising how to dance and sing.
By now, every animal in the jungle knew how to dance and sing. Finally, on her birthday, Kukoo threw a party at her house where they all danced, sang and had a great time!
Forgo the Duck danced. Becto sang. Kukoo's voice was truly melodious ! Then, they all had some delicious party food.
Since then, every bird with the Koyel , sing and dance and have a lot of fun in the jungle. Seeing them, we too sing and dance on joyous occasions .
